description: Codex visual review of original jumping-in-place recordings. Broad jump-cycle windows count one Jump each; no other commands expected. These are not independently validated takeoff timestamps or game-latency labels. Reference and motion clips are separately recorded, not a continuous live session.

eli_pjump.avi.review: Every frame reviewed. Two airborne cycles; earlier sparse-grid labels incorrectly counted ascent and descent as separate jumps.

ira_pjump.avi.review: Clip starts during a jump. Earlier presumed neutral frames and sparse-grid event counts were invalid; retain raw replay as a diagnostic without an accuracy score.
